market_source.provenance_note: The mdabbert page does not document which book its odds come from or whether they are openers or closes — one recorded price per side per bout (design draft section 3 disclosure). Book/timestamp undocumented.
market_source.route: Author's own GitHub mirror of the Kaggle dataset (repo README links the Kaggle dataset page; data/load_to_github_and_kaggle/dataset-metadata.json carries id mdabbert/ultimate-ufc-dataset, ownerUser mdabbert, license CC BY 4.0). Kaggle API keys are not available on this machine (repo Actions secrets only), so the Kaggle pull route was not used; the mirror is commit-pinned and hash-verified instead.
market_source.verification_vs_design_stated_shape: Design draft section 3 (verified by direct read of the Kaggle page Oct 27, 2026): per-bout rows with Red/Blue American odds plus derived profit columns, winner in {Red, Blue, Draw}, ~6,900+ priced rows across 2010-2026. Mirror file matches: 6,924 priced rows, R_odds/B_odds plus R_ev/B_ev derived columns, Winner in {Red, Blue, Draw} plus 3 No Contest rows (excluded from scoring), dates 2010-03-21 to 2026-03-28. Column names in the mirror file are R_odds/B_odds (the draft prose paraphrases them as Red/Blue American odds columns). The mirror is a living file (the pinned commit re-scraped 2025+ events); this pin attests the bytes as pulled at the recorded timestamp.

per_fight_source.dataset: UFCStats per-fight record via the repo's existing history route (sportsedge/ufc_history.py defaults)
per_fight_source.role: Feature reconstruction (career aggregates rebuilt point-in-time by sportsedge.ufc_history.build_history_from_text) and the design draft section 5 pre-screen audit of the market dataset's shipped aggregates. This is the same source the repo's production UFC history pipeline already consumes; no site was scraped for this screen.

purpose: Data pins for the UFC moneyline flagship design screen (Leg 1) — research/ufc_moneyline_screen_20261028. The repo stores hashes only; data files are pulled to a local data dir and verified against these pins before any run.
